message: The other day, I found myself chatting with my kids about fire safety while we roasted marshmallows in the backyard. It hit me that we never really sat down to talk about our escape plan—but hey, who knew making it a game could be so much fun? 🏃‍♂️ Now, we’ve got our own little fire drill practice, and it’s become our favorite family tradition. Sometimes, it’s the low-tech moments that teach us the most. How do you keep safety fun at home?
